question.text: The Price-to-Book (P/B) ratio is MOST commonly used for valuing:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Banks and financial firms have assets carried close to market value — P/B works well. **The Trap:** Software/tech firms have intangible assets that P/B underrepresents. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same use in XV. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Use tangible book for BFSI — goodwill can distort comparisons.
